comparisons.peer_summary: The company enters into master netting arrangements with counterparties to mitigate credit risk and allow for net settlement of amounts owed. Consequently, derivative assets and liabilities that can be net settled with each counterparty are presented on a net basis in the consolidated balance sheet.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron utilize master netting arrangements to mitigate credit risk in derivative transactions and allow for net settlement with counterparties. However, Intel specifically quantifies its credit exposure limit, stating that total credit exposure to any single counterparty did not exceed $1.4 billion as of December 28, 2024, whereas Micron states that the amounts netted under its master netting arrangements were not significant, without providing a specific exposure cap figure.

sentences.text: We enter into master netting arrangements to mitigate credit risk in derivative transactions by permitting net settlement of transactions with the same counterparty.

As of December 28, 2024, our total credit exposure to any single counterparty, excluding money market funds invested in US treasury and US agency securities and reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by treasury and agency securities, did not exceed $1.4 billion.
We enter into master netting arrangements with our counterparties to mitigate credit risk in derivative hedge transactions.
These master netting arrangements allow us and our counterparties to net settle amounts owed to each other.
